name: Greatech Technology Berhad
overview: 2026年公司没有发布涉及业务扩张、新业务、缩减或出售的公告，公告主要为季度业绩、股东大会及董事委员会成员变动。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收同比减少9.9%，净利润同比增长29.5%。
overview_en: In 2026, the company did not announce any business expansion, new business, reduction, or divestment; announcements were mainly quarterly results, general meetings, and changes in board committee memberships. In the latest quarter (30 June 2026), revenue decreased 9.9% year-on-year while net profit increased 29.5% year-on-year.
